steps.description: @assertion the startup "Welcome to VS Code" sign-in overlay is visible and its Close button is available.
Click the Close button on the startup Welcome sign-in overlay.
@assertion the startup sign-in overlay is no longer visible and the VS Code workbench is ready.
Press the F1 key to open the Command Palette in Visual Studio Code.
@assertion the Visual Studio Code Command Palette is visible with a > character in its input box and is ready to accept a command search.

parameters.text: Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View

steps.description: Type the resolved command title into the active Command Palette.

@assertion the Command Palette input box reads >Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View and the highlighted command listed under it is titled Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View.
Press Enter to execute the selected Command Palette command.
@assertion the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit view is open in the side bar and an editor tab labeled Welcome showing the Build a Declarative Agent walkthrough is open in the editor area.
@assertion the editor tab labeled Welcome showing the Build a Declarative Agent walkthrough is the active editor tab in the Visual Studio Code editor area.
Press Ctrl+W to close the Welcome editor tab.
@assertion no editor tab is open in the Visual Studio Code editor area.
Press the F1 key to open the Command Palette in Visual Studio Code.
@assertion the Visual Studio Code Command Palette is visible with a > character in its input box and is ready to accept a command search.
Type the resolved command title into the active Command Palette.
@assertion the Command Palette input box reads >Microsoft 365 Agents: Create New Agent/App and the highlighted command listed under it is titled Microsoft 365 Agents: Create New Agent/App.
Press Enter to execute the selected Command Palette command.
@assertion the active prompt titled New Project is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled New Project has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label Teams Agents and Apps into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option Teams Agents and Apps is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Teams Agent or App Using Microsoft Teams SDK is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled Teams Agent or App Using Microsoft Teams SDK has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label Other Teams Capabilities into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option Other Teams Capabilities is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Teams Capability is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled Teams Capability has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label Message Extension into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option Message Extension is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Programming Language is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled Programming Language has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label TypeScript into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option TypeScript is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Workspace Folder is visible and the option Default folder is focused.
Press Enter to confirm the Default folder option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Application Name is visible.
Type the authored value into the active text prompt.
Press Enter to submit the accepted text input.
@assertion the Preview README.md editor tab is open in Visual Studio Code.

```bash
import base64
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

project = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve()
assertions = json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ["ASSERTIONS_B64"]).decode("utf-8"))
for assertion in assertions:
    target = (project / assertion["path"]).resolve()
    try:
        target.relative_to(project)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise AssertionError("File assertion escaped the project directory") from error
    exists = target.is_file()
    if exists != assertion["exists"]:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected file existence for {assertion['path']}")
    if not exists:
        continue
    content = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for expected in assertion.get("contains", []):
        expected = expected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if expected not in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected content is absent from {assertion['path']}")
    for unexpected in assertion.get("notContains", []):
        unexpected = unexpected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if unexpected in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected content is present in {assertion['path']}")
PY
```

Press Enter to execute the selected Command Palette command.
Type the resolved option label into the active option picker.
@assertion the option Debug in Microsoft 365 Agents Playground is visible and selectable in the filtered option picker.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered option.
@assertion the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground page is open in the browser.
Click the "+" button at the bottom of the chat input box in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application interface to open the message extension type menu.
Click the "Search Command" option in the "Select a type of Message Extension" dropdown menu at the bottom center of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground interface.
Click the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" expandable section in the "Search-Based Message Extension" popup within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click the "Command ID" input field in the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" section within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web interface.
Type 'searchQuery' into the 'Command ID' input field in the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" dialog of the Search-Based Message Extension in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click the "Enter a search term" input field in the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" dialog within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Type text: 'test' into the "Parameter name" input field within the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" dialog of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.

Click the first dropdown item labeled "Item 1" in the search results below the "Parameter name" input after entering "test" in the "Specify Command ID or Parameter" dialog of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click the Send (paper plane) button in the message input box at the bottom of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground chat interface.
Click the "+" (attach) button in the message input box at the bottom of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground chat interface.
Click the "Action Command" option in the "Select a type of Message Extension" dropdown within the chat interface of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Type 'createCard' into the "Command ID" input field within the "Action-Based Message Extension" dialog in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.

Click the radio button labeled "Static list of parameters" in the "Select how to create your dialog" section of the "Action-Based Message Extension" dialog in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.

Click the "Create" button at the bottom-right of the dialog in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application, confirming the action to submit the static list of parameters for the "createCard" command.
Click inside the "Title for the card" input field within the "Your Message Extension App" dialog to focus and enable title entry.
Type the text '1' into the "Card title" input field in the "Your Message Extension App" pop-up dialog within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click on the "Subtitle" input field within the "Your Message Extension App" dialog to focus and enter a subtitle for the card.
Type text: '2' into the "Card title" input field in the "Your Message Extension App" dialog within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click inside the "Text" input field labeled "Text for the card" in the "Your Message Extension App" dialog of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web interface.
Type text '3' into the 'Subtitle' input field of the 'Your Message Extension App' dialog in the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Click the "Submit" button in the "Your Message Extension App" popup, located below the text input fields within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application interface.
Click the send (paper airplane) button in the message compose box at the bottom of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground chat interface to submit the current message.
Click the "+" (add) button in the message compose box at the bottom of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground chat interface to open the message extension options menu.
Click the "Link Unfurling" option in the "Select a type of Message Extension" popup menu within the chat interface of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.
Type 'https://botframework.com' into the single-line input field within the "Enter an URL" dialog of the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application.

Click the "Send to Conversation" button in the "Enter an URL" popup dialog within the Microsoft 365 Agents Playground web application to submit the entered link. The button is highlighted with a blue background and white text at the bottom right of the dialog.
@assertion there's "Unfurled Link" exist.
